switchFrameIntervals.scope: requestAnimationFrame intervals in the full instrumented Electron run; not GPU duration or display presentation FPS

validationScope: Actual built Electron main/preload/renderer, isolated empty database. Decode, Worker delivery and TextureLoader src were selectively delayed/failed at external resource boundaries; real state machine, material renderer and interactions retained. No actual library or audio files accessed.
limitations: One earlier instrumented run had a renderer-process crash (exitCode -36861); complete rerun passed without renderer errors.
First build attempt hit a Node heap allocation failure; production build succeeded with per-process V8 memory flags; final budget check still reports the existing 145.61 MiB font total above 110 MiB.
Draw-call submission CPU times and rAF intervals do not measure GPU completion or displayed FPS.
